BROKI MIGRATION V3 — PostgreSQL + n8n DataTable → Supabase RAW → canonical

Cobertura verificada:
- Todos los workflows: WhatsApp producción, dashboard producción y desarrollo.
- Todas las tablas del esquema pro se descubren dinámicamente.
- Alias public usados por workflows antiguos: personal, furgonetas, gse, registro_comunicaciones, tool_control.
- DataTable n8n: nitro_stock.
- HTML legacy: inventario, personal, incidencias, planner, aviones, stock nitro y tooling.

Requisitos env n8n:
- SUPABASE_URL
- SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
- BROKI_N8N_SECRET

Requiere desplegar:
1) broki-import-batch V3 adjunto
2) migración SQL 20260804_broki_migration_v3_audit.sql

No contiene secretos hardcodeados. Falla ante cualquier lote parcial o diferencia de conteos.

parameters.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.broki_export_all_legacy_raw()
RETURNS TABLE(
  source_system text,
  source_schema text,
  source_table text,
  external_id text,
  row_data jsonb,
  source_count bigint,
  is_empty boolean
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
DECLARE
  cfg record;
  table_reg regclass;
  candidate_keys text[];
  candidate_expr text;
  pk_cols text[];
  pk_expr text;
  pk_pairs text;
  base_expr text;
  export_sql text;
  exported_rows bigint;
BEGIN
  FOR cfg IN
    SELECT
      n.nspname::text AS source_schema,
      c.relname::text AS physical_table,
      CASE WHEN n.nspname = 'pro' THEN c.relname ELSE 'public__' || c.relname END::text AS source_table,
      CASE
        WHEN n.nspname = 'pro' THEN 'n8n_postgres_pro'
        ELSE 'n8n_postgres_' || n.nspname
      END::text AS source_system
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
      AND (
        n.nspname = 'pro'
        OR (
          n.nspname = 'public'
          AND c.relname = ANY(ARRAY[
            'personal',
            'furgonetas',
            'gse',
            'registro_comunicaciones',
            'tool_control'
          ]::text[])
        )
      )
    ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname
  LOOP
    table_reg := to_regclass(format('%I.%I', cfg.source_schema, cfg.physical_table));
    IF table_reg IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'BROKI migration table disappeared: %.%', cfg.source_schema, cfg.physical_table;
    END IF;

    candidate_keys := CASE cfg.physical_table
      WHEN 'personal' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','cod_empleado_aena','telefono']
      WHEN 'inventario' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','identificador','matricula']
      WHEN 'incidencias' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','id_incidencia','id_objeto']
      WHEN 'grupo_trabajo' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','id_avion','matricula','hora_salida']
      WHEN 'tareas' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','codigo','matricula_avion']
      WHEN 'aviones' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','matricula','id_avion']
      WHEN 'tooling' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','bac','bac_bact','codigo','descripcion']
      WHEN 'tool_control' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','bac_bact','bac','date_out']
      WHEN 'furgonetas' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','identificador','matricula']
      WHEN 'gse' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','brk','identificador','descripcion']
      WHEN 'registro_comunicaciones' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','id_chat','telefono','fecha_mensaje_in']
      WHEN 'n8n_chat_histories' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','session_id']
      WHEN 'no_existe_telefono' THEN ARRAY['external_id','id','telefono']
      ELSE ARRAY['external_id','id','uuid','identificador','brk','codigo','id_incidencia']
    END;

    SELECT string_agg(
      format('NULLIF(BTRIM(to_jsonb(t)->>%L), '''')', candidate_key),
      ', '
    )
    INTO candidate_expr
    FROM unnest(candidate_keys) AS candidate_key;

    SELECT array_agg(a.attname ORDER BY u.ordinality)
    INTO pk_cols
    FROM pg_index i
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(attnum, ordinality)
    JOIN pg_attribute a
      ON a.attrelid = i.indrelid
     AND a.attnum = u.attnum
    WHERE i.indrelid = table_reg
      AND i.indisprimary;

    pk_expr := NULL;
    IF array_length(pk_cols, 1) = 1 THEN
      pk_expr := format('NULLIF(BTRIM(to_jsonb(t)->>%L), '''')', pk_cols[1]);
    ELSIF array_length(pk_cols, 1) > 1 THEN
      SELECT string_agg(
        format('%L, to_jsonb(t)->%L', col_name, col_name),
        ', '
      )
      INTO pk_pairs
      FROM unnest(pk_cols) AS col_name;
      pk_expr := format('''pk:'' || md5(jsonb_build_object(%s)::text)', pk_pairs);
    END IF;

    base_expr := format(
      'COALESCE(%s%s, ''row:'' || md5(to_jsonb(t)::text))',
      candidate_expr,
      CASE WHEN pk_expr IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', ' || pk_expr END
    );

    export_sql := format($fmt$
      WITH source_rows AS (
        SELECT
          to_jsonb(t) AS row_data,
          t.ctid::text AS physical_row_id,
          %s AS base_external_id
        FROM %s AS t
      ), ranked AS (
        SELECT
          row_data,
          physical_row_id,
          base_external_id,
          count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY base_external_id) AS duplicate_count,
          row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY base_external_id
            ORDER BY md5(row_data::text), physical_row_id
          ) AS duplicate_index,
          count(*) OVER () AS source_count
        FROM source_rows
      )
      SELECT
        %L::text AS source_system,
        %L::text AS source_schema,
        %L::text AS source_table,
        CASE
          WHEN duplicate_count = 1 THEN base_external_id
          ELSE base_external_id || '#dup:' || duplicate_index::text
        END::text AS external_id,
        row_data,
        source_count::bigint,
        false AS is_empty
      FROM ranked
      ORDER BY external_id
    $fmt$,
      base_expr,
      table_reg,
      cfg.source_system,
      cfg.source_schema,
      cfg.source_table
    );

    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE export_sql;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS exported_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    IF exported_rows = 0 THEN
      RETURN QUERY SELECT
        cfg.source_system,
        cfg.source_schema,
        cfg.source_table,
        NULL::text,
        NULL::jsonb,
        0::bigint,
        true;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$$;

SELECT
  source_system,
  source_schema,
  source_table,
  external_id,
  row_data,
  source_count,
  is_empty
FROM pg_temp.broki_export_all_legacy_raw()
ORDER BY source_schema, source_table, external_id NULLS FIRST;
